title: He said he’d come on Thursday

options.text: He told to me the time

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: Tell takes the listener directly: told me. Correct: He told me the time

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: Tell takes the listener directly: told me. Correct: He told me the time

options.text: She said me she was busy

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: Use said + clause, or said to me + clause; not said me. Correct: She said she was busy

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: Use said + clause, or said to me + clause; not said me. Correct: She said she was busy

options.text: He asked us to leave a key
He asked us leave a key

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: A reported request uses ask + person + to + base verb. Correct: He asked us to leave a key

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: A reported request uses ask + person + to + base verb. Correct: He asked us to leave a key

options.text: She asked me to not calling early
She asked me not to call early

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: Use ask + person + not to + base verb for this negative request. Correct: She asked me not to call early

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: Use ask + person + not to + base verb for this negative request. Correct: She asked me not to call early

phrases.displayText: I spoke to the building manager about the leak
phrases.translation: Conversei com o gerente do prédio sobre o vazamento

phrases.displayText: He said the plumber would come on Thursday morning
phrases.translation: Ele disse que o encanador viria na manhã de quinta-feira

phrases.displayText: Yes. He told me the appointment was between nine and eleven
phrases.translation: Sim. Ele me disse que a consulta seria entre nove e onze horas

phrases.displayText: I’ll be at work. Did he ask us to leave a spare key?
phrases.translation: Estarei no trabalho. Ele pediu para deixarmos uma chave reserva?

phrases.displayText: He did. He asked us to leave it at reception
phrases.translation: Sim, ele fez isso. Pediu que deixássemos na recepção

phrases.displayText: Okay. I’ll do that before I leave
phrases.translation: Certo. Farei isso antes de ir embora
